content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in early cycles, especially when sentiment is bullish.", "Sentiment spikes near historical highs trigger model overcorrection and price overshoot.", "Model bias toward gradual upward trends persists despite sharp true price reversals.", "True price movements often lag model forecasts by 3–5 days, indicating delayed market reaction.", "Sentiment decay after peak bullishness correlates with forecast divergence and price correction.", "Model forecasts exhibit mean-reversion bias when true prices deviate significantly from recent highs.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment aligns with recent price momentum rather than isolated spikes.", "Models underperform during sentiment volatility, particularly when sentiment shifts from bullish to neutral."]}
